title: ME60138: Cfd In Manufacturing Processes
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

A brief overview of the basic conservation equations in heat transfer and fluid
flow, classification of partial differential equations and physical behaviour,
role of initial and boundary conditions. Common methods of discretisation: an
overview of finite difference, finite elememt and finite volume methods and
their relative merits and demerits in solving heat transfer and fluid flow
problems. The Finite Volume Method for diffusion, convection-diffusion, and
fluid flow problems. Examples with single phase flows in manufacturing
processes. Phase Change problems in materials processing and their CFD
modeling. Enthalpy-porosity approach for melting-solidification. Phase-field
model. Introduction to turbulence modeling and its application in materials
processing (such as continuous casting). CFD for laser aided materials
processing.
